title.zh: 查询直播推流回调配置

descriptions.zh:
调用本接口可以查询回调地址和回调鉴权信息。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为1000次/分钟。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
You can call this API to query the webhook address and authentication information for an ingest domain.

## QPS limits

You can call this operation up to 1,000 times per second per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you may experience service interruptions.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live describe-live-streams-notify-url-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name demo.aliyundoc.com --region cn-hangzhou
